title: Grammy's Allie Book
author: RambleBook
blurb: Allie is 7 years old — silly, determined, and curious all the way through. In this story, Allie and Grammy fly a cardboard rocket to a moon made of pancakes. A keepsake storybook about Allie, made for Grammy to keep, to show, and to read aloud.
makerLine: Made with RambleBook · Shelved at Narristotle, the bookstore
